name: Disable And Enable All Assign Block
description: Admin form to bulk enable/disable all blocks assigned to chosen regions of the default theme in one action.
project_description:
This module help to Disable and Enable all assign blocks to particular regions in one time.

 In the Admin config, the checkbox checked it means the assigned block is disabled and un-check means all assign block is enabled.

 Users can do for disabling and enable all assign blocks at one time.

 For example:- You have assigned multiple blocks in the Right side region and the client said we want to disable the right sidebar for some time. After some time you can enable all right sidebar sections. This module help for such cases and more.

 #Block #Disable #Enable

 Install it like any other module 

 composer require drupal/disable_enable_all_assign_block
